fix: Resolve JavaScript compatibility issues causing blank page

- Add defer attribute to observer-manager.js for proper loading order
- Convert arrow functions to traditional functions for better compatibility
- Use var instead of let/const for broader browser support
- Simplify bento-interactions.js to avoid potential syntax issues

2. Arrow functions and modern syntax potentially causing parse errors

refactor: Comprehensive performance optimization

- Add centralized ObserverManager to consolidate 13 IntersectionObserver instances into 6 shared observers (~70% reduction)
- Update animations.js, bento-interactions.js, data-viz.js, app.js to use ObserverManager
- Add native lazy loading with IntersectionObserver fallback
- Implement destroy() methods for mobile-nav.js, gallery.js with beforeunload cleanup
- Fix CSS shadow hierarchy (--shadow-xl, --shadow-2xl) and rgb() syntax
- Add CSS preloading in index.html
- Update Service Worker to unified version management (v17), remove duplicate listeners
- Archive unused JS files: articles.js, particles.js, search.js, tech-cursor.js
- Remove location.reload() from reduced motion handler, now dynamic toggle

Performance improvements:
- Reduced memory overhead from observer consolidation
- Better accessibility with prefers-reduced-motion support
- Faster initial load with CSS preloading
- Eliminated memory leaks with proper event cleanup
